capabilities: render ChordPro lead sheets with per-syllable chord alignment
transpose per file and toggle between concert pitch and capo shapes
show guitar chord diagrams on hover, tap, or as a full-song strip
build set lists that scroll several songs as one view with Prev/Next
autoscroll songs paced by duration with a performance mode
extras: Beta plugin installable via BRAT; includes a companion CLI to validate, transpose, export to JSONL, and derive chord-progression frontmatter; full ChordPro schema is in a separate SPEC.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render ChordPro notation, transpose songs, show chord fingerings, or support hands-free scrolling during performance.

relations.evidence: Chord diagram popovers were inspired by Obsidian Chord Sheets by Marcel Schaeben.

summary: Renders ChordPro lead sheets with per-file transpose, capo-aware shapes, guitar chord diagrams, set lists, and autoscroll for performance.
